headline: 1.4 MILLION PILLS
dek: They moved through hotels, apartment complexes, Airbnb rentals and self-storage facilities in six states, an AP investigation found.

nodes.text: DEA agents stake out a hotel and watch a deal of as many as 100,000 pills go unseized.
A record bust of 4 million fentanyl pills, separate from the 1.4 million that went unseized.
The DOJ inspector general opens a review on Aug. 17 of department-wide policies, using a judgmental sample across multiple jurisdictions.
AP counts at least 1.4 million additional pills that went unseized between August 2024 and April 2025.

means.label: The DEA:
means.text: The agency previously said its decisions were lawful and coordinated with federal prosecutors to prevent public harm.

means.label: Still unaccounted for:
means.text: Almost all of the monitored pills remain unaccounted for, AP reported.

sources: Sources: AP, Nov. 24; DOJ OIG, Aug. 17.
